exit_policy: finite_deviation retained; nonfinite/structural/execution failures exit nonzero

parameter_update_witness.scope: first up to 16 scalars of every actual Parameter; not a full-parameter trajectory comparison
first up to 16 scalars of every actual Parameter; not a full-parameter trajectory comparison

observations.comparison: capacity training execution only; no one-device equivalence reference or checkpoint
observations.continuation: carry detached private state into the next update; Timed flush contributes to loss and advances the resumed clock
observations.timing: complete wall time includes zero_grad, forward/readout/necessary flush/loss, backward, cross-device transport, AdamW, detach, final all-device sync and intervening diagnostic stage record IO; individual host phases exclude stage IO and measure device latency only with phase_sync
observations.audit_scope: separate graph-enabled forwards at each update's identical parameters, input and private state; no update or detach of the timed state
observations.memory_scope: timed allocator peaks reset after audit graphs are released; reserved bytes can retain construction/audit caches; process RSS covers the whole process
observations.initial_parameter_hash_format: sha256 of ordered name, shape, dtype and contiguous CPU bytes; zero-copy memoryview

placement.optimizer: placement_adamw; align disconnected shards per original Parameter before step
placement.communication: single-process autograd tensor.to copies of actual predecessor banks; no HCCL replicas

operator_witness.materialization_definition: logical output bytes from dispatched copy/index/concatenate operations; not hardware bus traffic, bandwidth or all operand loads
operator_witness.instrumentation: separate ordinary forward without semantic counting hooks; excluded from timing
